title: Covered Bridge Chip Plant burned 2024
description: On March 1, 2024, the Covered Bridge Chip plant in Waterville was destroyed by fire; a total loss. According to CBC, firefighters from several departments responded to the blaze at the Covered Bridge Potato Chips factory near Hartland, a major employer in the New Brunswick community. The call came in at 6 p.m., and 20 to 30 employees were safely evacuated. The business began as a potato distribution plant in 2004 and expanded into potato chip production in 2009. This four-generation family farming enterprise grew more than 500 acres of potatoes for the chip manufacturing industry.
